capitals.name: Rachakonda
capitals.note: 'Rachakonda was the base, southeast of Golconda'; a second base at Devarakonda. Coordinates approximate (not in the gazetteer).

rulers.name: Anapota Nayaka and Maada Nayaka
rulers.note: Joint leaders of the 1368 campaign; the page gives 'r. 1375-1435' for the dynasty and no reign years for them.

correction.text: Telangana, the region the Recherlas 'dominated' from Rachakonda and Devarakonda

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no Recherla row). 'became the dominant power in the Telangana region during the late 14th century and early 15th century (r. 1375-1435)'; the page names no frontier. The Telangana region (the state) is my reading; the Musunuri heartland round Warangal and Khammam is in it, the Krishna-Godavari coast is not.

ledger.note: 1368: the Recherlas take Telangana at Bhimavaram. 'In a battle fought at Bhimavaram in 1368, Kapaya Nayaka was killed and the Recherlas got control of Telangana'; the Musunuri page: they 'annexed the territories that had once been under Musunuri control' and 'became the dominant power in the Telangana that lasted till 1435'.

1435: the Bahmanis hold Warangal and Rachakonda. The sultanate 'captured Warangal as well as Rachakonda by 1435'; 'the Recherla chiefs remained small players scattered throughout Telangana'. The Bahmani attacks began 'in the 1420s'.

wars.name: Battle of Pangal
wars.outcome: A coalition of 'the Vijayanagara, Recherlas and Rajahmundry Reddys was victorious' at Pangal Fort in 1419; no land changed hands on the page.

wars.name: Bahmani conquest of Telangana
wars.outcome: The Bahmanis, once allies, attacked in the 1420s and held Warangal and Rachakonda by 1435.

certainty.note: No boundary is given; Telangana is the state of the gazetteer.

sources.title: Recherla Nayaks
sources.note: Telangana 1368-1435, Rachakonda and Devarakonda, Pangal 1419, the Bahmani conquest by 1435.

sources.title: Musunuri Nayaks
sources.note: Kapaya Nayaka killed at Bhimavaram in 1368; the Recherlas annex the Musunuri territories.

notes:
No Cliopatria row. One page (Recherla Nayaks), with the Musunuri Nayaks page for 1368. The page gives no infobox, no founding year (the 1375-1435 reign range is for the dynasty), no capital dates, no ruler list; the Telangana state is a reading. 1368 is the Bhimavaram year of control; 'r. 1375-1435' is the page's range.
Not settled: the extent (Telangana as a whole or the Nalgonda country only); the alliance with the Bahmanis before the 1420s; the end ('by 1435'); the Kapilendra alliance of 1435 (not on the page).
Counterparts: musunuri-nayaks (this batch), bahmani-sultanate (sa-04-c), vijayanagara-empire (sa-04-c), reddi-kingdom (this batch).
